Upgrading a 0.2.1 installation while preserving data still requires its original key.
No physical-phone installation or uninstall was performed.

Changes:
- Camera JPEG grid automatically requests the next 24 items when scrolled to its end.
- Single pending request, old-request identity guard, failure pause with explicit retry,
  advancing empty filtered pages and nonadvancing-cursor rejection.
- Appends update the current GridView; native saved view state preserves the camera
  handle and scroll offset through viewer/navigation/layout changes.
- Black full-screen fitted photo, hidden system/app bars, overlay Back/name/save actions.
- Single tap toggles controls; double tap/pinch zoom and bounded drag use native detectors.
- Explicit save retains the displayed bitmap and zoom.
- Full JPEG previews are temporary and pinned while viewed; two entries / 128 MB total,
  64 MB per automatic preview. No preview is added to the downloaded-photo list.
- Explicit download copies a complete matching preview rather than transferring it twice.
- Partial, mismatched or malformed receives are not published as complete cache/downloads.

Limits:
No physical-camera Wi-Fi, actual photo corpus, weak-network, tablet, TalkBack or hardware
pinch/gesture test was performed. Automated cache/pagination checks do not certify those.
No NP2/NP3, RAW/video, Nikon pairing or new camera-compatibility claim was introduced.

Independent album review:
Disposition: SHIP, limited to the reviewed phone album UI scope.
The independent reviewer examined all 11 final-APK phone-album screenshots listed above
and AlbumPanel, PhotoImageView, AlbumPaging and MainActivity; no material issues were found.
This conclusion does not extend the emulator evidence to physical-camera Wi-Fi,
camera compatibility or any untested scene identified in Limits.

Subsequent physical-phone installation and startup finding:
After the emulator/UI review above, the user explicitly requested phone installation
and had removed the old package from the main user. User 0 reported installed=false,
but an old package remained under system_clone user 10. That residual package was
removed for user 10; 0.3.1-beta then installed on PKG110 / Android 16 with an APK hash
matching this record. This later installation supersedes the earlier no-phone-install
statement, which describes the original emulator review only.
The first launch crashed: MainActivity.render called PhoneWindow.getInsetsController
before DecorView existed, producing a null pointer exception inside PhoneWindow.
Final delivery therefore moves to 0.3.2-beta / versionCode 14, which initializes DecorView
before obtaining and checking the system-bar controller. The fix does not change the UI
design. Version 0.3.2 build/install/phone-launch verification is still pending; see
nikon-usb-0.3.2-beta-VALIDATION.txt for its final hash and results when recorded.
All JVM, screenshot, emulator and independent-review evidence above remains scoped to
0.3.1-beta and is not a claim that 0.3.2-beta has been fully retested or passed on phone.
